  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: parse_suspect_compare sets `commits_page_truncated = total > len(parsed)` and `commits_returned = len(parsed)` from the filtered list instead of the raw GitHub commits list (raw_commits). As a result, one malformed or non-hex SHA dropped by `_suspect_commit_entry` makes render_suspect_commits_section (lines 6894-6896) falsely say GitHub listed only the oldest N commits and that the newest are missing.
  WHY: The false caption misleads the heal plan into searching outside the actual commit range. Severity is disputed: gemini and minimax rated it MAJOR, which maps to high and is used here; openai rated it NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 dropped the same item in its pass-1 notes because GitHub's compare API does not return non-40-hex SHAs.

  WHY: Gemini rated this BLOCKER (mapped to critical). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash dispute it. They found that the assertion `intake.index("skip reason=provider_unavailable") < intake.index("# --- Fingerprint")` still holds (line 1855 < 1860). The PR's hunks start at line 3099 or later. === END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "If the trend says `regression=true`, also list the default-branch commits merged on the first slow day: one `GET repos/<repo>/commits?sha=<default>&since=<day 00:00Z>&until=<next day 00:00Z>&per_page=50` call."
  expected_change_site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:_heal_build_suspect_commits (the `if [ "${SOURCE_REPO,,}" = "${SELF_REPO,,}" ]` guard around suspect_default_branch) and scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:suspect_commits (the `default_branch_unavailable` branch before the commits argv is built)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: `PROVENANCE_DEFAULT_BRANCH` is passed only when `SOURCE_REPO == SELF_REPO` (lines 3340-3342 of `scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh`). The trend step still runs for consumers (`run-time-trend --repo "${SOURCE_REPO}"`, intake line 3244), so consumer reports with `regression=true` always end as `partial/default_branch_unavailable` and leave out the first-slow-day commits (lines 7027-7030 of `scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py`). The implementation does not resolve the consumer repo's default branch, and the issue does not defer this case. The suggested fix is to leave out `-f sha=...` so GitHub uses the repository's default branch. That keeps the one-call budget.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

That keeps the one-call budget and is about 6 lines plus tests and fragment text.

  PROBLEM: `result["commits_page_truncated"] = total > len(parsed)` and `result["commits_returned"] = len(parsed)` use the filtered `parsed` list rather than `raw_commits`. A non-hex SHA therefore triggers a false "GitHub listed only the oldest N; the last M of those shown, the newest are not listed" caption. `test_parse_suspect_compare_fixture_lists_8192_and_pipeline_files` covers only all-valid SHAs in the paged case.
